summary: Independent review of Jinshu 086 owned units s0002–s0210 (minus s0140) covering Zhang Gui, Zhang Shi, and the Liangzhou cast through the Chang'an fall. Year-level conversions that rest on the Chinese itself are supported: 永甯初 as Hui Di Yongning 1 / AD 301; 永興中 as Yongxing AD 304–306; 永嘉初 as Huai Di Yongjia 1 / AD 307; 湣帝即位 and 建興初 as Min Di Jianxing 1 / AD 313; 四載於茲 / 逼遷天子 as Jianxing 4 / AD 316. Unyeared sequels after 永嘉初 correctly use onOrAfter 307 without a second endpoint. 漢末 anecdotes stay unresolved. Gui's 卒年六十 is kept as traditional inclusive sui and is not turned into a birth year; 在州十三年 versus conventional Jianxing 2 leaves the 313/314 death open on both Gui records and on Shi's succession. Retrospective citations (ancestral names, Han precedents, 諡曰武公, 討曹祛, 劉載 in the edict) are not used as living activity. Defects that block approval: s0007 泰始初 is Gui receiving office through uncle Xi, yet p005 carries AD 265–265; Hui's 惠帝遣加 is closed to Yongxing though the Chinese does not date the honor; Suo Fu, the 是時 Beidi raid, Qu Tao, and Xin Pan are given invented Jianxing 1 / 313–313 years; Liu Yao's 自去年九月 is dropped from the 316 campaign window; Min's death is dated 316 from 逼遷 rather than from later 崩問; and three hint sets overstate Lang's Shanggui march, Rui's being named while 遠在江表, and Bao's undated 會保薨 as 318–320 / Taixing 3.
